blocks.prompt: 2. The 3rd term of a G.P. is 16 and the 6th term is \(-128\). Find the first term and the sum of the first seven terms.
blocks.explanation:
G.P. ke do terms maloom hain; humein pehla term \(a_1\) aur pehle saat terms ka sum \(S_7\) chahiye.
Plan: \(a_3\) aur \(a_6\) ki equations likhenge, unhein divide kar ke \(r\) nikalenge, phir \(a_1\), aur aakhir mein \(n = 7\) ke saath sum ka formula.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(a_3 = 16\), \(a_6 = -128\).
Humein find karna hai: \(a_1\) aur \(S_7\).
Tareeqa: General term \(a_n = a_1 r^{n-1}\) dono terms ke liye likhenge. Do equations aur do unknowns (\(a_1\), \(r\)); divide karne se \(a_1\) khatam ho jata hai aur seedha \(r\) mil jata hai.

Do equations likhein
\[a_1 r^{2} = 16 \quad (1)\]
\[a_1 r^{5} = -128 \quad (2)\]
Kyun: 3rd term ki power \(3 - 1 = 2\) aur 6th term ki power \(6 - 1 = 5\).

(2) ko (1) se divide karein
\[r^{3} = \dfrac{-128}{16} = -8\]
\[r = -2\]
Kyun: \(a_1\) upar neeche cancel ho gaya, aur \(\frac{r^{5}}{r^{2}} = r^{5-2} = r^{3}\). Ab woh number chahiye jis ka cube \(-8\) ho: \((-2)(-2)(-2) = -8\), is liye \(r = -2\).
Dhyan dein: \(r = 2\) ghalat hai; \(2^{3} = 8\), \(-8\) nahi. Negative ratio ka matlab hai terms ka sign baari baari badalta hai.

Pehla term nikalein
\[a_1(-2)^{2} = 16\]
\[4a_1 = 16 \Rightarrow a_1 = 4\]
Kyun: \(r = -2\) ko (1) mein rakha. Negative number ki even power positive hoti hai: \((-2)^{2} = 4\). Phir dono taraf 4 se divide.

\(S_7\) nikalein
\[S_7 = \dfrac{4\left[1 - (-2)^{7}\right]}{1 - (-2)}\]
\[= \dfrac{4(1 + 128)}{3}\]
\[= \dfrac{4 \times 129}{3} = 172\]
Kyun: Odd power par minus qaim rehta hai: \((-2)^{7} = -128\), to \(1 - (-128) = 129\). Neeche \(1 - (-2) = 3\). \(129 \div 3 = 43\), aur \(4 \times 43 = 172\).
Dhyan dein: Minus ke andar minus ka khayal rakhein; yahin sab se zyada ghaltiyan hoti hain.

Tasdeeq: saaton terms jama karein
\[4, -8, 16, -32, 64, -128, 256\]
\[4 - 8 + 16 - 32 + 64 - 128 + 256 = 172\]
Kyun: 4 se shuru kar ke har dafa \(-2\) se multiply kiya. 3rd term 16 aur 6th term \(-128\) hai, jaisa sawal mein diya tha, aur sum bhi 172 aaya.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein "2. 4, 1723.(i)" chhapa hai: Sawal 2 ke jawab aur agle hisse "3.(i)" ke darmiyan space ghaib hai, is liye yeh \(1723\) parha jata hai. Durust jawab \(a_1 = 4\) aur \(S_7 = 172\) hain.
